fabric.securityProfile: Repository canonical demo/local-network fixtures; not a live external Clearing House or portal journey
fabric.counting: Eight complete journeys; consent-rule assets and HTTP steps are not additional cases.

logHandling: User paths, disposable JWT values and any private-key PEM are redacted. Complete originals remain in private operator custody. Trailing whitespace in expected-red contract logs is normalized.
knownLimitations: No end-to-end claim about a revoked business credential being refused by an external verifier.
No cross-cloud staging or authenticated GDC portal claim.
Three pre-existing general-suite omissions are disclosed separately and excluded from accepted policy counts.
